threshold_rule: On source validation only, select the lowest observed score satisfying the false-alarm budget after chronological silence. Include a no-alert threshold. Each method has its own frozen threshold.
exposure: Known-outcome history-eligible issue days within complete calendar follow-up, including positive and negative days. Unknown outcomes can still trigger and silence alerts; report their alerts separately.
events: Union overlapping or adjoining positive target intervals for each person. A timely hit requires a positive-window alert strictly before the earliest covered day. Count each event once. Lead is operational, not a clinical onset time.
